page.overview:
Who is Mika Anjiliac Chiera?

Mika Anjiliac Chiera was a male Force-sensitive Dark Jedi Hutt of the Anjiliac kajidic, one of the two offspring of Popara Anjiliac Diresto, and a crime lord. Mika owned an Esral'sa'Nikto aide named Orgamon.

Born years prior to the formation of the New Republic, Mika was the son of Anjiliac kajidic leader Popara Anjiliac Diresto, and the younger brother of Zonnos Anjiliac Priare. After his father found out that Mika was Force-sensitive, Mika and Popara kept it a secret. However, Mika also wanted to buy and train with a lightsaber, but his first attempts at building one failed, and due to his species' natural clannish tendencies, training options were few and far between. At some point, Mika created a super spice that was a variation of glitterstim and a virus from the Hutt home planet of Varl. He eventually named this new spice Tempest.

At some point, Mika coerced the Jedi Knight Toro Irana into training him, getting Irana addicted on Tempest as a means of controlling, as well as mind tricks to ensure his own safety and to manipulate others. Eventually, Irana died of a Tempest overdose and his former mentor, Jedi Knight Mander Zuma, came to the planet of Makem Te looking for answers. Around this time, Mika lost contact with his father Popara shortly after a plague out broke on the planet.

Eventually, Mander found Mika and returned Mika to Popara. Mander found that Mika was a peculiar Hutt, since he appeared to be polite, erudite, slim, and spoke Basic comfortably. Shortly after Mika returned to Nar Shaddaa, he had his father murdered, prompting his brother Zonnos to hire the Huttese bounty hunter Parella the Hunter of the Jiramma clan to find out who murdered Popara. Mika soon became Angela Krin's contact within the Anjiliac kajidic, and somehow convinced Krin to take up the job of finding the Tempest's creator and soon led her to Nar Shaddaa. Though, when Mander revealed that he thought Popara's "explosive death" and the Tempest incident were connected, Mika and company were attacked by Zonnos' mercenaries. Eventually, Mika and Reen Irana were knocked unconscious and kidnapped by the mercenaries.
